title: A Word on Machine Ethics: A Response to Jiang et al. (2021)
findings: The paper finds that the Delphi model conflates religious prohibitions (e.g., against Mormons drinking coffee) with moral judgments. This is used as evidence to critique the model's flawed approach of grouping various types of norms under a single umbrella of 'descriptive morality' without proper distinction or context.
